nodes.text: @vonderleyen @EU_Commission @ECDC_EU Due to US CDC, FDA, NIH etc being downsized and quiet it is necessary for EU to step up. At the moment the Bird flu is risking becoming a epidemic or even a pandemic, Covid-19 is still going on, and there is also RSV, Mycoplasma, Flu and HMPV.
